blind.description: A stylized architectural stone gargoyle or spout carved from mossy, aged green-tinted stone. The front features the head of a roaring beast or lion-like monster with an open mouth forming an open spout channel. Extending backward is an elongated rectangular stone block with carved wing or relief motifs along the flanks and a flat, channeled upper surface leading to a squared mounting block at the back. All surfaces are solid, continuous, hand-painted/stylized, and free of defects or floating shards. The model rests flatly on the ground plane.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as an elongated rectangular block with a squared rear end, a recessed trough or flat groove running down the spine flanked by sculpted wing shapes, tapering slightly before widening at the beast's horned or spiky carved head with open mouth at the bottom.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the figure (around 1.4 to 1.5 ft tall) and roughly 3.5 ft long.
